item.description:
# Super Shout 2.0
- Apple SpeechAnalyzer transcription on macOS 26 with automatic model preparation and a classic-engine fallback. - Phone and meeting mode with separate local-microphone and computer-audio transcripts. - AI meeting summaries, decisions, action items, open questions, and Markdown export. - Live microphone diagnostics for no signal, quiet audio, good signal, and clipping. - Automatic formatting modes by app, plus user-defined app groups. - Voice snippets that expand spoken triggers into reusable text. - Searchable transcript library with optional AI recall across recent history. - Signed Sparkle updates that download and install automatically after this release.
